alarmed.definition: Experiencing a sudden feeling of fear, apprehension, or awareness of danger.
alarmed.example: He was alarmed by the sudden noises coming from the corridor.

cry.definition: A loud, inarticulate sound made by a person, expressing pain, grief, or alarm.
cry.example: The alarmed cry echoed through the narrow streets at night.

bat.definition: A nocturnal mammal with forelimbs adapted as wings for flight.
bat.example: Look over there! It's a bat flying across the sky!

detective.definition: A member of the police force or a private investigator investigating offenses.
detective.example: The detective arrived at the observation post.

hardware.definition: Physical equipment, specialized mechanical apparatus, or tactical gear.

manufacturing.definition: The industrial process of producing goods or machinery on a large scale.

monologue.definition: A lengthy speech presented by a single character in a drama or dialogue.
monologue.example: The speaker delivered a dramatic monologue on stage.

mayor.definition: The elected head of an administrative city or municipality.
mayor.example: Schedule a briefing with the Mayor this afternoon.

cape.definition: A sleeveless cloak hanging loosely from the shoulders.
cape.example: He wore a heavy weatherproof cape in the storm.

goggles.definition: Protective eyewear with surrounding shields against dust, impact, and glare.
goggles.example: Put on your protective goggles before entering the lab.

hat.definition: A shaped headwear worn for warmth, protection, or formal style.
hat.example: Look, I found the hat near the entrance!

city.definition: A large human municipality and urban center.
city.example: We have to protect this city before nightfall!

trick.definition: An optical illusion, deception, or skilled act of craft.
trick.example: That is merely a trick of the light.

light.definition: Electromagnetic radiation perceptible to the human eye; illumination.
light.example: The searchlight cut through the dense fog.

fledermaus.definition: Kleines nachtaktives Säugetier mit zu Flügeln umgebildeten Vordergliedmaßen.
fledermaus.example: Sieh mal da drüben! Es ist eine Fledermaus!

umhang.definition: Ärmelloses Kleidungsstück, das locker um Schultern und Rücken gelegt wird.
umhang.example: Der dunkle Umhang wehte im Wind.

schutzbrille.definition: Brille, die die Augen vor Staub, Splittern oder grellem Licht schützt.
schutzbrille.example: Setz deine Schutzbrille auf, bevor wir anfangen.

stadt.definition: Größere, geschlossene Siedlung mit eigener Verwaltung.

schrei.definition: Lauter, unartikulierter Laut, meist Ausdruck von Schmerz oder Furcht.
schrei.example: Ein gellender Schrei zerriss die Stille.
